intro.text: Thryv is a software-led platform company focused on enabling small and medium-sized businesses (“ SMBs ”) to run and grow their businesses more efficiently with artificial intelligence (“ AI ”) tools and automations. Our strategy is centered on delivering a unified, extensible SaaS platform that supports customer acquisition, engagement, operations, and retention across the SMB lifecycle. As of December 31, 2025 , we serve approximately 230,000 SMB clients through our two business segments: SaaS and Marketing Services. SaaS represents the strategic growth engine of the Company. Marketing Services is our legacy segment that we are actively managing and exiting as part of a multi-year transition to a pure SaaS business model.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: Our growth strategy is focused on the growth and expansion of our SaaS offerings; however, during 2025, 41.3% of our revenue was derived from our Marketing Services offerings.
As of December 31, 2025, 139 employees, or 5% of our employees and 18% of our sales force, were represented by unions.
Approximately 86 % of Marketing Services revenue in all periods presented was derived from sales to local SMBs that operate in limited geographical areas.
The remaining approximately 14 % of Marketing Services revenue in all periods presented was derived from the sale of marketing services to larger businesses that advertise regionally or nationally.
In 2025, the Company's top ten directories, as meas ured by revenue, accounted for approximately 1 % of total revenue.
Revenue from customers located in Australia was approximately 13.0 %, 14.4 %, and 15.3 % of total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 , respectively.

We rely on intellectual property laws, including trade secrets, copyright, patent, and trademark laws in the United States and abroad and use contracts, confidentiality procedures, non-disclosure agreements, employee disclosure and invention assignment agreements, and other contractual rights to protect our intellectual property.

The success of new or enhanced functionality and features depends on several factors, including their overall effectiveness and the timely completion, introduction and market acceptance of the enhancements, new features, or applications.

Furthermore, we depend on both internal development and our third-party software partners to develop and implement their own enhancements, new features, or applications that can then be integrated into the Thryv Platform.

To the extent we rely on third-party AI models in our products, services and solutions, we will face risks inherent in how those models have been developed and deployed, including situations in which the third party may lack a proper license or consent for the training data used for their model.

The success of our Thryv Platform depends on several factors, including the market acceptance of our Thryv Platform, the ability to maintain and to develop relationships with third-party service providers, and the ability to attract, retain, and effectively train sales and marketing personnel.
Our ability to further penetrate our existing markets depends on the quality of our Thryv Platform and add-ons and our ability to design our solutions to meet consumer demand.

Furthermore, our ability to increase sales from existing clients depends on our clients’ satisfaction with our services and our clients’ desire for additional solutions and to expand from single-point solutions to our comprehensive Thryv Platform.

Furthermore, the success of any geographic expansion depends on our ability to customize products to integrate with third-party applications in that region and other market specific customizations, translate products for non-English speaking markets and provide customer service and training in local languages, which we may be unable to do successfully.
In order to grow our business, we anticipate that we will continue to depend on the continuation and expansion of relationships with vendors and other third parties.
In our Marketing Services segment, we depend upon third parties to print, publish and distribute our directories.
Additionally, we rely on the expansion of our relationships with our third-party providers as we enhance our service offerings.
We rely on third-party service providers for many aspects of our business.
We rely on third-party service providers for many integral aspects of our business.
We depend on our third parties for many services, including, but not limited to:
We also rely on a third-party solution for order entry and monthly payment processing for Thryv orders.

We host our consumer-facing internet sites, which are a major source of low-cost fulfillment traffic for our clients and serve most of our digital service clients from data centers operated by third-party providers, primarily Amazon Web Services.
In our Marketing Services segment, we depend on third parties to supply paper and to print, publish and distribute our directories.

In connection with these services, we rely on the systems and services of our third-party service providers, their ability to perform key functions on our behalf in a timely manner and in accordance with agreed levels of service and their ability to attract and retain sufficient qualified personnel to perform services on our behalf.

Our future success will depend upon our ability to anticipate and to adapt to changes in technology and industry standards and to effectively develop, introduce, market and gain broad acceptance of new product and service enhancements incorporating the latest technological advancements, including robust AI solutions.
Furthermore, we depend on our third-party providers to also keep pace with rapid technological changes and evolving industry standards.
We rely on data provided by third parties, the loss of which could limit the functionality of our platform and disrupt our business.
Our business depends on the overall demand for marketing solutions, especially business management software by SMBs, and on the economic health of our current and prospective clients.

The extent to which a public health epidemic or outbreak impacts our operations will depend on future developments, including the duration of the outbreak, the severity of the outbreak and the actions to contain the outbreak or treat its impact, among others.

We depend on our senior management team, and the loss of one or more key employees or an inability to attract and to retain highly skilled employees could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We also rely on our leadership team in the areas of marketing, sales, services and general and administrative functions and on mission-critical individual contributors in all such areas.
Our success also depends on our ability to identify, hire, train and retain qualified sales personnel.
In addition, the employees of some of our key suppliers are represented by unions.

Clients may depend on our solutions to enable them to comply with applicable laws, or may not fully comprehend the applicable laws’ impact on them when using our solutions, which requires us and our third-party providers to constantly monitor applicable laws and to make applicable changes to our solutions.
Clients may rely on our solutions to enable them to comply with applicable laws in areas in which the solutions are intended for use.
We rely on these systems to process, on a daily and time sensitive basis, a large number of complicated transactions.

We rely upon a combination of patent, trademark, copyright and trade secret laws as well as contractual arrangements, including confidentiality or license agreements, to protect our intellectual property rights.
Our success depends upon our not infringing upon the intellectual property rights of others.
Utilization of these net operating losses depends on many factors, including our future income, which cannot be assured.
Once our solutions are deployed, our digital services clients depend on our support organization to resolve technical issues relating to our platform.
